title: The Free-Energy Certification: PAC-Bayes Bounds as Governed AI Admission Criteria
description: Preprint. The McAllester PAC-Bayes bound and Friston's Free Energy Principle decompose into the same two terms: accuracy (empirical risk) and complexity (KL divergence). We exploit this identity to define a governed certification for AI models with Lean proof status, statistical bounds, and cryptographic receipts.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Companion receipts in SZLHOLDINGS/model-eval-receipts.
